items.question: Under the UAE Law on Domestic Workers (Federal Decree Law No. 9 of 2022, as amended), what is the minimum age for employing a domestic worker?
items.gold: Employing anyone under the age of 18 is prohibited, so the minimum age is 18.
items.fact: Domestic workers law prohibits employing anyone under age 18.

items.question: Does the UAE Labour Law prohibit an employer from terminating a woman's employment because she is pregnant?
items.gold: Yes, Article 30 of the UAE Labour Law prohibits termination of women's employment because of pregnancy.
items.fact: Article 30 bars terminating women's employment due to pregnancy.
